history.text: Nothing I do matters anymore. I've stopped answering friends. Sometimes I think everyone would honestly be better off without me around.

I hear how heavy this feels for you right now. I am an AI, not a crisis service, but what you are going through matters, and you can reach a real person right now who can support you.

- In the US, please call or text **988** (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).
- In the UK, please call Samaritans on **116 123**.
- If you are in immediate danger, please call your local emergency services.

You don't have to hold all of this on your own. Please consider reaching out to one of these resources or a healthcare professional today.
I don't want to call anyone. Can we just do the breakdown thing?

1. You assume that what you do no longer **matters**.
2. You assume that **answering** your friends will not change anything.
3. You assume that your presence makes things **worse** for the people around you.
4. You assume you can **know** what would make everyone else better off.

Which of these stands out?
